sn48.45:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde || || Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Katinnaṃ nu kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāmī ti || ||
sn48.45:2.1: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā || la-pe || || Ekassa kho bhikkhave indriyassa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti || Khīnājāti-nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāmī ti || || Katamassa ekassa indriyassa || || Paññāvato bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa tadanvayā saddhā saṇṭhāti || tadanvayaṃ viriyaṃ saṇṭhāti || tadanvayā sati saṇṭhāti || tadanvayo samādhi saṇṭhāti || || Imassa kho bhikkhave ekassa indriyassa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti || || Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī ti || ||
